findings.description: The callback rebinds the enclosing `package_name` through `nonlocal` and overwrites it with the resolved distribution name. This side effect is unnecessary, because only the local lookup needs the distribution name.
findings.rationale: Trigger: the option is invoked with an import name such as `PIL`. The callback sets `package_name` to `Pillow`, and the `%(package)s` message field then shows `Pillow` rather than the name the user passed. If the callback runs again, it skips the fallback and reuses the changed value. The effect is limited. It may even be intended, since the distribution name is arguably the better one to display.
